responsibility: Contains the main RTL machine description for the Alpha architecture. It defines Alpha-specific UNSPEC codes, attributes, mode/code iterators, and the bulk of instruction patterns, expanders, splits, peepholes, and asm templates for calls, addressing, arithmetic, floating-point operations, GP/TLS relocation sequences, and ABI-specific instruction forms. This file is the generated-code specification that maps GCC RTL onto concrete Alpha instructions and instruction attributes consumed by reload, scheduling, and final emission.
same_name_distinction: Machine-description member of the Alpha stem: it is the declarative RTL insn/pattern and attribute specification used by GCC generators, distinct from alpha.cc's C++ backend procedures, alpha.h's target-definition macros, and alpha.opt's command-line option declarations.
